## `sheets_add_conditional_format_rule`

Class: create

Add a conditional format rule. Specify either booleanRule (single trigger condition + format) or gradientRule (min/mid/max color stops).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `spreadsheetId` | string | required | Spreadsheet ID |
| `ranges` | array | required | Ranges the rule applies to |
| `index` | number | optional | Where in the rule order to insert (0 = highest priority) |
| `booleanRule` | object | optional |  |
| `gradientRule` | object | optional |  |

## `sheets_batch_update`

Class: update

Generic spreadsheets.batchUpdate pass-through. Accepts the full Request union (~70 types). Use this for advanced operations not covered by a dedicated tool. See https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `spreadsheetId` | string | required | Spreadsheet ID |
| `requests` | array | required | Array of Request objects. Each object has exactly one key (the request type) like {repeatCell: {...}}, {addChart: {...}}, {updateBanding: {...}}, etc. |
| `includeSpreadsheetInResponse` | boolean | optional |  |
| `responseRanges` | array | optional |  |
| `responseIncludeGridData` | boolean | optional |  |

## `sheets_format_cells`

Class: update

Apply uniform formatting (colors, fonts, alignment, number format) to every cell in a range. Uses RepeatCell with a computed fields mask. For borders use sheets_update_borders.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `spreadsheetId` | string | required | Spreadsheet ID |
| `range` | object | string | required | Target range: a GridRange object (half-open indexes), or an A1 string such as "Sheet1!A1:D10" (the sheet title is resolved to a sheetId with one extra call) |
| `backgroundColor` | object | optional | Cell background (RGB 0..1) |
| `textFormat` | object | optional |  |
| `horizontalAlignment` | enum | optional |  |
| `verticalAlignment` | enum | optional |  |
| `wrapStrategy` | enum | optional |  |
| `numberFormat` | object | optional |  |

## `sheets_set_data_validation`

Class: update

Apply a data validation rule (dropdown, checkbox, numeric range, etc.) to a range. Pass conditionType=null to clear validation.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `spreadsheetId` | string | required | Spreadsheet ID |
| `range` | object | required |  |
| `conditionType` | string | required | BooleanCondition.type. Common values: NUMBER_GREATER, NUMBER_BETWEEN, TEXT_CONTAINS, TEXT_EQ, DATE_BEFORE, BLANK, NOT_BLANK, CUSTOM_FORMULA, BOOLEAN, ONE_OF_LIST, ONE_OF_RANGE. |
| `conditionValues` | array | optional | Values per condition type (list items for ONE_OF_LIST, range A1 for ONE_OF_RANGE, etc.) |
| `inputMessage` | string | optional | Tooltip shown when cell is selected |
| `strict` | boolean | optional | Reject invalid input (default: false = warning only) |
| `showCustomUi` | boolean | optional | Show dropdown UI for list-type validations |
